wrap_optimizer_with_larc: wrap a pytorch optimizer with LARC to calculate adaptive local learning rates for large batch training
configure_larc_trust_coefficient: configure LARC with a custom trust coefficient to control the ratio between gradient and parameter magnitudes
toggle_larc_clip_mode: toggle LARC between clipping mode and scaling mode by setting the clip parameter to True or False
run_larc_optimizer_step: run an optimizer step with LARC that modifies gradients using adaptive local learning rates before updating parameters
save_and_load_larc_state: save and load the LARC optimizer state dictionary to persist training progress across sessions
